At first, Sun-Woo's antics drive him crazy, but soon, his charm begins to grow on Min-Hyuk. Just as Min-Hyuk starts to enjoy their unusual cohabitation, Sun-woo drops a bombshell confession that turns his world upside down. With his peaceful life in turmoil, Min-Hyuk must navigate his feelings and the unexpected twists that come with living with someone as unpredictable as Sun-Woo. In high school reunion, Hanada met again with the flashy Hashizaki, a now-Host who had been admiring him for a long time. Suddenly, Hashizaki offers to comfort Hanada with his mouth to the drunk Hanada?! Will his reunion with Hashizaki, bring the brightness from their youth days back? She filled the letters with lies to protect her mental image. Then one day, she receives a letter from the student; Yoarashi has come to school. While Ogino is anxious about her lies being exposed, Yoarashi tells her, "I came to help you, Ms. Ogino." Thus, beginning their "education!"

Haunted by visions of DIO's overwhelming presence and pursued by a mysterious foe, the four have to join forces to get to the bottom of this mystery, its ties to The World's user deeper than any of them thought they could be.

After that incident, Ju-Yeong kept on getting strange dreams of Sang-Hyeok... as he becomes conscious of the latter. What is to become of this encounter?

Ryouji Saeki, a young engineer, has just returned home from Europe, and as he helps plan for the construction of a hydroelectric power plant, his daily life has taken a feverish pace. By his side is the loyal attendant Edward, who Ryouji took under his wing two years ago. Little by little, how does their relationship as master and servant begin to shift...?

"It feels so nice, I can't stop..." Okiya is regarded as both a reliable and kind-hearted senior coworker by those at his company. Okiya, however, has a secret ability up his sleeve. Armed with the ability to read people's emotions based on their aura, he is seamlessly able to build strong relations with his peers. One person that catches his eye, though, is a subordinate by the name of Koga. Though a socially awkward and expressionless member of the team, Koga emits a strong "aura of affection" towards Okiya, making him feel extremely pleasant to the point of wanting to reciprocate. One night, after one drink too many, Koga's aura makes Okiya feel so good that he renders him.... wanting something more...! A clumsy love story between an honest, unabashed subordinate, and his intelligent, beautiful senior coworker who both just want to "feel good".

Life seemed perfect for Oriana after she started dating Vincent in the winter of her fifth year at the academy. Little did she know, her beloved would soon die under suspicious circumstances. Before she can process anything, she wakes up to find herself back in her seven-year-old body with no idea how she died. When she finally returns to the magic academy in hopes of reuniting with her boyfriend, she finds out Vincent has no memory of her! Now she's back at square one. Can Oriana navigate this second chance at life and change the course of Vincent's fate? Making her crush work out really is a matter of life and death!

The animals living on the farm of Sae-Min’s family are not what they seem. Although they put up an act of innocence in front of Sae-Min’s family, they are fully capable of deliberately committing horrifying acts. Told from the point of view of an extremely intelligent old cat, this is a thrilling tale of jealousy, manipulation, and murder.

Hiroki Segawa is secretly dating his boss. However, he has hardly been able to see him these days.
After a night of drinking his sorrows away, he wakes up in a hotel bed with his younger coworker, Rui Mikami, as Rui whispers sweet nothings and passionately kisses him.
The friendly and always-smiling Rui starts to get aggressive even at work. He shows Hiroki a photo of Hiroki and their boss hugging, threatening to share the photo with the office unless Hiroki goes out with him...!

Hayul has no intention of dying alongside her new husband and demands a divorce. But when Claude turns down her repeated requests to end their marriage, she has no choice but to propose a deal. She gives Claude one month to win her love and change her mind, something she is determined to resist with all her strength, but her time with Claude leaves her feeling suspicious, restless, and uncertain. Will Claude be able to win Hayul over, or will they ultimately part ways?

(Source: Tappytoon)

She was considered a candidate to win the previous year's competition, but had an accident on the day of the competition, lost her mother, and left the skating world with an ugly scar on her leg. Yuri, however, gave a brilliant performance that showed no signs of her injury nor her two-year break. Chiyoko suddenly declared that she will form a skating pair between Yuri and Tsubasa without their approval, and that she will devote herself to coaching them.

138235.description:
I, Miyuki Oshima, a.k.a. Milky, just started junior high school since the end of spring. My home is a temple, and I felt a premonition in the night sky that something was about to happen. 138237.description:
Reborn as a vampire, Mercedes Grunewald has won the lottery of life. She's strong, quick, beautiful, and even a noble. Technically a noble, that is. Her mother is merely a concubine, and her father shows no interest in the family he's shunned to the countryside. Knowing the comforts of her life will be lost once he chooses an heir, she resolves to take matters into her own hands. At just ten years old, she begins a life of dungeon crawling. But what will she find for herself out there in the dungeons? In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but this time, she's set on achieving a different fate. Whether it be fame, fortune, or simply a reason to live, this time, her moon will be full.

During the summer vacation of her senior year of high school, Mio is enjoying playing in the river with her old friends as usual, when suddenly she discovers the secret of her childhood friend Kohei. The incident will eventually shake their relationship and their "world." A suspenseful coming-of-age fantasy colored by dazzling sunlight and limpid water.

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

But the truth is, Ryusei used to be a powerful demon king in another world! So why not spend this new life doing whatever he wants? Except, he wasn’t the only one reincarnated into this world. The hero who struck him down is here too—and she’s a really cute high school girl?! Can Ryusei survive reuniting with his foe in a new world, or will he find himself fighting even in this life?

138249.description:
I, Masako Sakai (an ordinary office-lady in her twenties), fell to my death from the stairs of a train station right after my boyfriend dumped me. But when I woke up, I was reborn as the villainess in an otome game called "Do-S Ouji Ranbu: Choose Me" in which all the male characters are sadistic boys...

I lived a modest life, unable to be my true self, and then to die so easily was just awful! In this life, I'm going to live the life I've always wanted! I'll do whatever I want before I die! The esteemed Evil slayer has made its first calling in 400 years, choosing Gun as the rightful Emperor of the HaeWol Kingdom. In a long and bloody battle, Gun, the hidden son of the late Emperor Hyeon Wui Jae, kills the tyrannical Hwang family that has been wreaking havoc across the land. When his older brother passes away, Gun ascends the throne as the Emperor, spreading hope that the days of turbulence and disorder are finally coming to an end. However, he has to set out on an important undercover mission to obliterate the corrupt accomplices of the Hwang family who are spread out beyond the city walls. In doing so, perhaps he will solve the missing puzzles that have been haunting him for years. The mystery behind why his only love Choa and her trusted father betrayed him. Even though he violently cut ties with Choa in fury, he can't resist her coming back into his heart. First as the irresistible courtesan Wol Hyang, then as the physician assisting his undercover mission. Will they be able to get past the painful memories from the past? Will they repeat the tragic love of Choa's parents?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

138265.description:
Living as a pseudo-couple with your favorite idol?!

The “perfect” idol Akira Sezai. Akira was my last hope after all the idols I had supported retired due to boyfriend revelations and harassment scandals. She’s the last idol I’m going to support. That’s what I had decided. I have a phobia of women and feel physically ill when I get close to one. Still, I mustered up the courage to attend Akira’s handshake event. That night, after a sluggish exchange of words and handshakes, Akira, for some reason, barged into my house.

“Will you be my boyfriend?”

Those words suddenly changed my daily life. I had only ever seen Akira standing on stage, but now she was revealing her offstage personality to me one after another. And the reason she approached me had nothing to do with becoming my lover… By spending time with an idol that I had only admired, I was able to see the dazzling brilliance and the abyss that lay beneath her. I’m afraid of women, but at the same time, I yearn for them. And while shining as an idol, Akira seems to be heading for destruction.

What lies ahead for the two of them as they play lovers?

The handsome Duke Voreoti is the most terrifying man in the empire, with the coldest of demeanors and a gaze that can kill. But one day, he suddenly says that he wants to… adopt a child?! And that child is me?! After finding me at a shady orphanage, he whisked me away to his snowy palace without a second thought. Now I’m learning all the ways of the feared Voreoti family from his knights. However, things get dicey when the Duke becomes suspicious of my origins. With these fangs and jet black hair, perhaps we are more than just kindred spirits…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Male Lead's Adopted Daughter
主人公の養女になりました
ฉันกลายเป็นลูกสาวบุญธรรมของท่านดยุก

title.english: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter

138364.description:
Kang Jae-Hyuk was mesmerized the first time he heard Ha-Jin play violin. He was so invested in Ha-Jin's continued growth that he even sponsored him through his cultural foundation. As soon as Ha-Jin hit twenty, however, he confessed his feelings for Jae-Hyuk and disappeared. Seven years later, the two reunite, but Jae-Hyuk is heartbroken to find that Ha-Jin's love for violin has completely vanished.

(Source: Tapas)

138365.description:
A compilation book with Fujisawa's hentai work whilst under the pseudonym, Mari Aizawa.
Contains the following titles:
1. P-Boys - Side One Gold Rush
2. Junko
3. Audio Visual Panic
4. Sexy-Summer
5. Tokyo Radical Artists Club
6. Psychadelic War
7. Sonna Konban no One Sceen: Tokyo Radical Artists Club Part II
8. Sailor Fuku Doori
9. My Darling
synonyms: Sonna Konban no One Sceen: Tokyo Radical Artists Club Part II

138366.description:
Ye Tian gained the power to copy others' talents. In order to protect his sister, he struggled to survive in the apocalyptic era of the invasion of exotic beasts. In order to become stronger, he began to explore the unknown world and gradually uncovered the secrets of the invasion of different dimensions...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Wo Neng Fu Zhi Tian Fu

title.native: サプライズ・クリスマス

138368.description:
One day, an ordinary boy suddenly gained two new step-sisters: a gentle, buxom older sister and a cute, devilish little sister!?
A slightly titillating family romantic comedy!
synonyms: I'm Sandwiched Between Sweet and Spicy Step-Sisters

title.native: 甘辛義姉妹に挟まれてます

138369.description:
Yumi Asaoka hates volleyball but various encounters will cause this conviction to waver and force her to grow up. Will the volleyball prodigy take the courts once again? The answer to that question lies in the letter "V"!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

138370.description:
Rei Yukino is a 15-year-old aspiring idol who works for Arisugawa Entertainment. She strives every day to become a singer and an actress, but there is always something weird with the jobs that come her way. The jobs that her manager Inaba brings her are often "out of this world"...

(Source: II V, translated)

title.native: レイの世界 ―Re:I― Another World Tour
title.romaji: Rei no Sekai ―Re:I― Another World Tour

138372.description:
Years ago, Kaijus appeared all over the world, at the same time, heroes appeared to face them. In Japan there is a hero who fights every day to protect the city of Dandelion, however she cannot bear to be in front of the cameras, which earned her the nickname Shy.

Note: One-shot that led to the actual story.

138373.description:
Tasuku is in love with his “cool and mysterious” neighbor, Shia. She’s three years older than him, a big film buff, and doesn’t like him back. The two get together to watch movies every Wednesday, but no matter how many times Tasuku attempts to use these meetups to profess his love for her, Shia sends him right back into the friend zone. Can Tasuku prove himself a mature and capable boyfriend? And what secrets is Shia hiding behind her smiley demeanor?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: I'm in Love with the Older Girl Next Door

title.native: アルパインクライマー　―単独登攀者・山野井泰史の軌跡―
title.romaji: Alpine Climber: Tandoku Touhansha Yamanoi Yasushi no Kiseki

138380.description:
Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Gal Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
Gibt‘s denn keine Gyaru, die nett zu Otaku sind?!
哪裡有溫柔對待阿宅的辣妹！？
สาวแกลไม่มีทางใจดีกับโอตาคุหรอก!?

title.english: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?
title.native: オタクに優しいギャルはいない!?
title.romaji: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!?

138381.description:
Tamaki Haru moved to a rural town with a Binbogami Shrine. He has the ability to see kami and spirits, and one day, he ran into a girl named Kazura when she fell off an electric pole. She claimed to be a kami herself, and that she was being chased by something. Tamaki was still confused when they were suddenly attacked by a mysterious monster. Set in Takamagahara, known as the home of the gods, this is the start of an action-packed tale of Japanese mythology!

(Source: Shonen Magazine, translated)

138382.description:
She is a police officer who has been living independently and accidentally crossed into another world on her way to work. What kind of story will she tell in this completely unknown world?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Forced to Be a Princess After Reincarnating in Another World
title.native: 穿越到异世界的我竟被迫做王妃
title.romaji: Chuanyue Dao Yishijie De Wo Jing Bei Po Zuo Wangfei?

138384.description:
"I don’t want to even breathe the same air as you!"

...are the last words Jeong Sang-Heon says to Yun Hae-Sin before they part ways. But after ten years, the two reunite and end up living together under the same roof. Sang-Heon is the worst roommate one could have. He makes a mess wherever he goes, constantly breaks things, brings over uninvited guests, and even smokes inside the house. When Hae-Sin is at his wit’s end, he finally finds out a weakness that helps him put a leash around Sang-Heon's neck. Will Hae-Sin successfully tame Sang-Heon so that they can live in peace together while breathing the same air?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
synonyms: นายตัวร้ายใต้ชายคารัก

138385.description:
I had a hard life. In my next life, I vow to find love which I never did!

I was born a rich person in my next life. One day, a strange poor man, Min U-Ju, won't stop bothering me?! But he's caught my attention... could he be the reincarnation of the unrequited love from my previous life?

138386.description:
Yeong-Jun, who has been living a perfectionist life until now, meets Tae-Eun through an anonymous chat after quitting his company. During their first meeting, seeing Tae-Eun staggering while drunk, Yeong-Jun is drawn to his imperfection...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

138387.description:
What does it take for a guy to get laid, you ask? Well, a hell of a lot of tries is the answer. Lee Si-Hyeon is a 21-year-old virgin who has been in the bottom rungs when it comes to getting laid—and it’s not the kind of bottom he aspires to be. After four failed attempts at having sex, Si-Hyeon’s fifth attempt is finally successful. Kind of. He wakes up in bed with his former-childhood-best-friend, present-arch-nemesis, Han Baek-Kyung. Baek-Kyung may not have been the top of Si-Hyeon’s list of eligible boys, but he could be the top Si-Hyeon needs to undo the curse on his sex life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 21 extra chapters.

138389.description:
"Weight training turns me on so much. I hate this body of mine...!!"

Hinamoto is concerned about his recent weight gain, the result of his irregular lifestyle! While he wants to do something about it, a certain issues has him reluctant to start exercising. It's then that he meets popular fitness trainer Saotome, who finds out about Hinamoto's "condition."

A romcom, weight-loss story about a cool trainer and a pure, glasses-wearing office worker.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Do I Have to Do It in Order to Lose Weight!? The Best Training I've Ever Had
title.native: やせるためにはイかなきゃダメですかっ！？―発情快感トレーニング―
title.romaji: Yaseru Tame ni wa Ikanakya Dame desu ka!? Hatsujou Taikan Training

138390.description:
In the land of the Xia Kingdom, every human being is born with what is known as a "resonance", either to a specific element or a powerful, mythical beast. Unfortunately, Li Luo was born with an incredibly rare condition known as an empty resonance! Meanwhile, his parents, the powerful masters of House Loulan, have gone missing for many years, and the other Great Houses are beginning to eye their holdings quite hungrily. Can this useless young master turn the tide?

(Source: Mangatoon)

Note: The original Chinese version is completed with 256 chapters while the English version is completed with 512 chapters.
synonyms: ราชันย์แห่งพลัง
코어 올마스터: 한계 찢고 왕의 길로

138391.description:
Aritoki's scent keeps getting stronger... And, his sweaty body, red face, and deep eyes draw Yuyu in deeper... Yuyu Kusakabe is a college student who wants to go into disexuality studies. After getting approval from her professor, she tries to become the assistant to fellow college student, Aritoki Ujyou, who's always cooped up in his lab, but he keeps turning her away. After repeated tries, Yuyu finally gets into the lab, but that's when Aritoki starts to have a flare-up... Aritoki's a disexual and has been advancing his studies by doing research on himself. Yuyu knows that the fastest way to control his flare-ups is to give him bodily fluids with someone else's DNA in it, so she...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A "Perfect" Flower -The Joining of a Fated Pair-
title.native: 両性花～交わる運命の番

138393.description:
Three girls born between my best friend and my first love. The eldest, she looks just like my first love. The second, she loves to flirt. And the third, young and innocent. My life will never be the same.

(Source: TOPTOON)

title.native: フレンチ・オブ・ザ・デッド

138395.description:
Art instructor Dongho seems to be caught in a love triangle with college students, but what will the three learn about each other when the uniform comes off?

(Source: Toomics)

138396.description:
Izumi is Micchan's adopted nephew, who he helped raise from the time he was small, after Izumi's mom died, and then as well after his dad died. Izumi always was possessive of Micchan's attention, even when he was young.

Izumi grew up and went to college and then eventually, at 20, he moves back home with Micchan. He surprise kisses Micchan and tells him he came home to become Micchan's lover!?

Despite his kiss attack, however, Izumi is respectful of Micchan's feelings of surprise and hesitation to enter into a relationship with a child he helped raise, who has now become a young man. They both try to be respectful of each other's feelings as they navigate their new dynamic and Micchan struggles with coming to terms with the new way he is coming to see Izumi.

138397.description:
Once a rising martial arts master, Ja-Gak Yang is known as the Ten Strike Finisher due to his ability to defeat any opponent within ten moves. Ja-Gak is also the son of the leader of the Great Martial Alliance, an organization of virtuous martial arts sects. His future leadership over the martial arts world seems all but assured -- that is, until he is assassinated by jealous rivals! Ja-Gak is reincarnated into the body of Cheon-So Ma, the playboy second-in-command of the evil Shining Light Cult. Can Ja-Gak remain true to his principles despite his new life on the dark side?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as the Crazed Heir
เกิดอีกทีเป็นว่าที่ประมุขลัทธิมาร

138399.description:
In his second year at his job, Haru Amakawa is transferred to a different office. On his first day there, he meets Seiji Nakahara, an older, friendly, and seemingly mature colleague. Upon their encounter, Haru, who has never been strongly moved by anything or anyone, experiences strong emotions for the first time. Haru attempts to get closer to Seiji, but he is met with a kiss and an invitation to fool around...

A cute romance featuring two characters truly falling in love for the first time!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: It Was The End Of Spring
title.romaji: Sore wa Haru no Owari ni

138400.description:
Rookie editor Amemiya takes over the responsibility of handling the popular mystery author Hayama Yaichi. However, he finds out that the author he admires is actually not good at cleaning up after himself and always has dark circles under his eyes. When Amemiya, worried about Hayama's health, forces him to get some sleep, Hayama suddenly hugs him and says, "...Then, let's stay like this for a while," and uses him as a pillow...?!

A healing love story between a gloomy author and a puppy-like junior editor!

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 葉山せんせいの抱きまくら
ニンジャと司教の再出発!
title.romaji: Ninja to Shikyou no Sai Shuppatsu!

138404.description: A corporate slave from Japan is reincarnated in ancient China during the Three Kingdoms period.

title.native: 偽典・演義～とある策士の三國志～
title.romaji: Giten Engi: Toaru Sakushi no Sangokushi

138405.description:
4 friends meet up from time to time. 3 guys and 1 girl. You can guess what they do during these sessions. But one day, one of them decides that he is unsatisfied doing it so rarely. It'd be for the best if it was just the two of them...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

138406.description:
Ryuichi Hasegawa, the top player in a strategic medieval RPG, is granted a special “bonus” by the developer and reincarnated into the game world—not as the protagonist, but as the villainous lord Erhin Eintorian who dies in the prologue! This means Erhin’s survival is a race against time, for his domain is set to be invaded by a hostile foreign power in just one day. In order to save himself, Erhin must use the leveling system that only he can access and his knowledge of the game to prepare his forces. The only hitch, of course, is that there’s no way a villainous lord left a functioning military at his disposal! Can Erhin forestall the tragic fate scripted for him, or is he doomed to play out his own demise?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: I Become a Rogue Lord in a World Where Only I Level Up
I’ve Become a Rogue Lord in a World Where Only I Can Level Up

title.english: Only the Villainous Lord Wields the Power to Level Up
title.native: 俺だけレベルが上がる世界で悪徳領主になっていた
title.romaji: Ore dake Level ga Agaru Sekai de Akutoku Ryoushu ni Natteita

title.native: けもの使いの転生聖女 ～もふもふ軍団と行く、のんびりSランク冒険者物語～
title.romaji: Kemono Tsukai no Tensei Seijo: Mofumofu Gundan to Iku, Nonbiri S Rank Boukensha Monogatari

title.native: けもの使いの転生聖女 ～もふもふ軍団と行く、のんびりSランク冒険者物語～
title.romaji: Kemono Tsukai no Tensei Seijo: Mofumofu Gundan to Iku, Nonbiri S Rank Boukensha Monogatari

138409.description: A new, idealistic wedding planner and her cynical, greedy boss will try to create unforgettable memories for their clients!

138410.description:
Maki Ibaraki is a high school girl who lives in Asakusa and loves Asakusa cuisine. This girl, who likes to poke her nose into ayakashi-related business and solve her problems by brute force, harbors a secret - she remembers her previous life. Her previous life was not that of a human, but of a demon princess called the "Ibaraki Kid," whose name resounded across the Heian period.

Accompanied by Kaoru Amasake, the reincarnation of her "husband" Shuutendouji, the "Strongest Demon-bride" hurtles around Asakusa even today helping troubled ayakashi, such as Kappa Temari who is exploited at his part-time job, and a family of tanuki who run a local soba restaurant.

title.native: 浅草鬼嫁日記 天酒馨は前世の嫁と平穏に暮らしたい。
title.romaji: Asakusa Oniyome Nikki: Tenshu Kaoru wa Zensei no Yome to Heion ni Kurashitai.

138413.description:
Hotori has always tried to be a "good girl" and live her life without making waves. When she forgot to bring the survey book for her teacher Enjou, she tried to sneak back into the classroom at night, only to find a man asleep, surrounded by painting supplies.

"So it was you!"

Hotori ran away when the sleepy man suddenly kissed her. But the next day at school, she is reunited with that man Kodo, who claimed to be the new substitute art teacher... He is not the type you would usually call a teacher, with his impudent and slovenly attitude. At Enjou-sensei's request, Hotori is pushed into modeling for Kodo's paintings......

A pure but inappropriate after-school romance between a lazy art teacher and a "nice" high school girl.

(Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes four volume-bonus chapters.

138415.description:
Karin's father is the most vicious and feared politician in the emperor's court, which made her an outcast amongst her peers. She became an apprentice lady-in-waiting, hoping to find friends in the ladies of the Imperial Court. But she found herself using her assassin's skills to protect the lonely young emperor instead.

Will Karin finally be able to make a friend?

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)
synonyms: 암살 후궁 암살 궁녀 · 화령은 평온하게 살고 싶어

title.native: 暗殺後宮～暗殺女官・花鈴はゆったり生きたい～
title.romaji: Ansatsu Koukyuu: Ansatsu Nyokan Karin wa Yuttari Ikitai

title.native: 愛するあなたと恋するきみが
title.romaji: Aisuru Anata to Koisuru Kimi ga

138418.description:
The story takes place in Nepal, a land inhabited by gods. In this country, a 10-year-old girl is chosen to spend 10 years as the "Karmali," a living god. Mina, who was once chosen as the Karmali, has completed her role and now lives as an ordinary girl. She is still in love with Aron, who served her when she was the Karmali. Then one day, Mina goes to a play and meets…

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

138420.description:
A crossover between GaoGaiGar and Betterman, set after the events of GaoGaiGar FINAL, using unused concepts from GaoGaiGar Final Project Z.

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters
synonyms: King of Kings: GaoGaiGar vs. Betterman

title.native: 覇界王〜ガオガイガー対ベターマン〜

138421.description:
Tae-U and Yun-Sol have always been an unlikely pair. As childhood best friends, both are too afraid of losing the other to admit their feelings. But when Yun-Sol's soul becomes a part of her doll after a messy accident, things get even more complicated. Will the two be able to find a way for Yun-Sol to become human again... and find love on the way?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

138422.description:
Sa-Rang Jin is one of the most famous actresses in South Korea, and she has it all—talent, good looks, and a loving fiancé... or not! One week before their wedding, her groom-to-be ghosts her. She desperately searches everywhere for In-Ha, only to discover he’s lied to her throughout their entire relationship. To her dismay, his secret triggers her own personal misfortunes with shamanism. Heartbroken and traumatized by her past, will she be able to accept him for who he is?

(Source: Tapas)

138423.description: Kouta Natsumi has been living a fun but unchanging life since he quit his surfing. One day, he get a birthday present from his class honour student, Michiru Oguri. Kouta becomes aware of Michiru Oguri. Every summer, the distance between the two becomes shorter and shorter.

title.native: アイスクリームライン

138426.description:
Rabi, a dragon who destroyed an entire continent at her birth, is held in a special prison dedicated to inhuman monsters.
The guard in charge of Rabi is a young man named Lucien, whose hometown was destroyed by Rabi.
She is an enemy to be hated, but Lucien finds Rabi too cute to hate even if he wanted to...

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

138427.description:
A routine call regarding a burglary at an empty mansion leads cocky young police detective Jin Saeki to a gruesome and shocking discovery. The corpses of 13 children, along with the presence of a strange symbol, spur a manhunt for Juzo Haikawa, the mysterious absentee owner of the house. So begins an investigation (and an obsession) that will take Jin all over Japan and into the darkest recesses of both the past and the human soul.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.english: Lonely Deaths Lie Thick as Snow
title.native: 降り積もれ孤独な死よ

138428.description:
A five-part series of one-shots published in the magazine Boys Life.

1. Zashiki Warashi (ざしきわらし)
2. Sensou (戦争)
3. Yama chichi (山父)
4. Oni (鬼)
5. Musashi (無三四)

Note: Zashiki Warashi was reprinted in first issue of Garo in 1964

138430.description:
How far must I fall before you forgive me...?
br> (Source: Fakku!)

138434.description: A newly appointed teacher Morizaki keeps visiting his truant student Mirai in hopes of getting him to return to school.

title.english: Those Who've Sunk to Rock Bottom
title.native: 水底に棲むこどもたち

138435.description:
Keigo Odagiri runs a detective agency in an old, run-down building on the outskirts of Tokyo with his assistant, Leo. All they get are relatively trivial cases, but they're happy as long as they have each other. They spend their days eating, sleeping, and after doing a little work, making love. Their simple, everyday life together is sweeter than anything...... This is a romantic story about two kind and gentle men!!

(Source: Renta)

Note: Includes an extra.

138436.description:
How far are you willing to go to protect your interests? For one Japanese vending-machine enthusiast, the answer is “to the grave.” Crushed by his favorite contraption, his life as a fanboy of dispensed goods may be over, but his close connection to vending machines can only grow—when he’s reborn as one in a fantasy world! Is a land of monsters and magic ready for this modern marvel of convenience?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Я переродився торговим автоматом і тепер блукаю підземеллям

title.english: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
title.native: 自動販売機に生まれ変わった俺は迷宮を彷徨う
title.romaji: Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou

138437.description:
Yukiteru Aoi is a college lecturer for the marine biology department. He loves the lunches at Akashi Kitchen, so he gets his lunch delivered from Kazuma Akashi who works there. For the past six months, they've been having special "lectures" on marine biology during Yukiteru's breaks. But, one day, Kazuma doesn't seem his normal self. As Yukiteru worries that Kazuma has gotten sick of him, one of his female students shows up in his lab and forces herself on him...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ふたりっきりのおいしいお時間

138438.description:
Honor. Glory. Justice. These are what martial artists fight for. Not Gumho Go, the second brother of the Baekdu Wind Sword Sect and the biggest slacker the martial arts world has ever seen. Spending more time sleeping than training, he’s perfectly happy being seen as a fool by his master and fellow disciples. But when the first brother is killed by a mysterious assailant, Gumho is forced to take his place as the eldest brother. As new enemies emerge to threaten the sect, Gumho is going to have to step up to become its unlikeliest protector!

(Source: Tapas)

138439.description:
Based on the Super Famicom Game Wonder Project J.

Note: Released in Enix Supercomic Gekijoh Volume 3.
synonyms: Super Comic Gekijou: Wonder Project J
Enix Supercomic Gekijou: Wonder Project J
スーパーコミック劇場 ワンダープロジェクトJ

title.native: ワンダープロジェクトJ

138440.description:
Contains:
1. Charin Ko Graffiti (チャリン娘グラフィティ)
2. Shiroi Message (白いメッセージ)
3. Fushime gachi Eve (ふしめがちイヴ)
4. Major Code de Love Step (メジャーコードでラブステップ)
5. Futari no Aki ni Somete (二人の秋にそめて)
synonyms: メジャーコードでラブステップ

title.native: チャリン娘グラフィティ

synonyms: A Woman Who Will Mess Up Your Emotions
The Woman Who Messes With My Emotions

title.native: 情緒をめちゃくちゃにしてくる女
title.romaji: Joucho wo Mechakucha ni Shitekuru Onna

138445.description:
Takao, the manager of a long-established inn, is approached by the landlady one day with a request: to train the inn's heir, Chiaki. Once an angelic little boy, Chiaki has grown into a bit of a playboy. The story of their love starts unexpectedly on his first day of training. That evening, when Chiaki is told he can't go out at night to mess around, he responds with an unusual request: "In exchange, if I try my best, I want to get a treat for it." When Takao agrees, he suddenly finds Chiaki inching closer... with a lustful expression. Shaking as Chiaki's hot tongue explores his mouth, he feels engulfed with a newly discovered pleasure.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 跡取り息子は我慢しない

138447.description:
Betrayed by his friends, Urea is banished and sent to live in the "Twilight World" where only demons dwell. Two years have passed since then, and Urea has struggled through and survived the Twilight World, while acquiring its power. Thus, the "jack of all trades and master of none" has become humanity's strongest sorcerer. Urea returns to the human world where he enrolls in elite training at the "School of Exorcism", is quickly selected to go from average rank to S-rank, and breezes through his rivals with his "phantom illusion" and "materialization" powers.

(Source: HobbyJapan, translated)
synonyms: A Banished Failure Survives in the Borderland and Becomes an S-Ranked Exorcist

title.native: 追放された落ちこぼれ、辺境で生き抜いてSランク対魔師に成り上がる
title.romaji: Tsuihou sareta Ochikobore, Henkyou de Ikinuite S-Rank Taimashi ni Nariagaru

138448.description: A couple have a cute interaction over a ribbon
synonyms: The Ribbon Wearing Female MC Is Too Pure

title.native: リボンヒロインはだいたい天然
俺の彼女はかわいくない

138453.description:
A young man starts working at a burger joint after learning that it's full of hot girls.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

138454.description:
From growing up in a dysfunctional family to being cheated on, So-Jin never had it easy. So after waking up in the body of villainess Reilynn Candmion, daughter of the empire’s wealthiest duke, all she wants is to revel in her riches. After losing her parents at a young age to a monster attack on their village, Alicia is sent to an orphanage, where she spends three miserable years being mistreated—and doing her best to smile through it all. After finally reaching her limit and running away, Alicia is attacked by a strange woman who wants to take the young girl’s place as the protagonist of something called an otome game.

Now adrift in an unforgiving world, Alicia vows to grow stronger by any means necessary. She’ll need all the might she can muster if she has any hope of changing her fate and fighting for survival.

In the near future, the world is a desolate place occupied by the undead. Strange crystals emit a deadly zombie virus as the last remnants of humanity struggle to avoid infection and survive. Despite all this, life is relatively peaceful for young Ruby, who lives in the Amina Safe Zone with her father and a small band of other survivors. All of this changes when Ruby encounters Arvan, a white-haired young man with pale skin and no heartbeat. This meeting sets off a series of events that force Ruby and her father to embark on a journey to discover the truth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Shiro used to be a cafe worker, and Ko was one of his regular customers whom he had a bit of a crush on, but an unfortunate accident leaves the cafe he works at burnt to the ground. With the owners being too old to do anything to rebuild the cafe, they entrusted the land to Shiro, who had always thought of opening his own shop. To help with finances, Ko invites Shiro to work with him at the host club he works and even offers Shiro to live with him. Considering the circumstances, Shiro agrees. But it seems that working and living with Ko is more complicated than what Shiro expected. Ko seemed to be keen at harassing and making a manservant of Shiro any chance he gets, and Shiro's virgin self could only take so much. Though one student still lingers in his memories, memories which he's trying so hard to forget. As fate would have it, Satomi meets his student again: Usui, now grown up and a teacher. Will the two of them be able to settle things from eight years ago and find closure?

After Kakeru explains that he's so broke he can't even afford to eat, he asks Arashi for his help to finish a project he received, in exchange for paying rent. Sometimes, we only discover our true gifts when we hit rock bottom. Take Da-Min Lee -- he’s a terrible soccer player, due to his almost supernatural talent at dodging any object thrown at him. But in another sport? It’s a whole other story. When Da-Min leaves the soccer team in disgrace after failing to save the game-deciding goal, he’s discovered by Tae-Gyun, captain of the épée team in the school fencing club. Impressed by Da-Min’s agility and evasiveness, Tae-Gyun offers Da-Min a chance at redemption in fencing. Will Da-Min find his true passion and make some friends along the way?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

138576.description:
Poor law school student, Jeong-Hun Han, experiences a time slip via the time roulette machine he accidentally finds at his father's place. When he comes to his senses, he finds himself in the middle of a battlefield during the Joseon dynasty! But before Jeong-Hun can even process what’s happened, he’s approached by a messenger named Jun, who informs him that the only way he can go back to his time period is by completing the time roulette’s mission. 138590.description:
In order to save her beloved grandmother's land, Rebecca barges into the boardroom of a huge company in Manhattan. Slade has become rather bored with his daily life, so he welcomes the fierceness this young beauty brings with her. He listens to her demands, and then tells her that he loves her, but Rebecca only cares about her land. However, Slade always gets what he wants, so he makes Rebecca an offer that she can't refuse. He'll help her produce the heir she needs to keep her land.

(Source: Harlequin)

138591.description:
A world where the worth of one's life is decided by one's Level.
Theo, an S-Rank adventurer, had reincarnated thousand years later in a future where the people had forgotten about the power called "Level Up." In this world where a person would be Level 1 at birth, humanity is persecuted as the weakest race and the people lived everyday while fearing the danger of monsters. However, in their midst only Theo, who was chosen to be a sacrifice for the monsters, knew that humans can become the strongest because only they have the ability to Level Up.

Happiness continues even if there is no thread of fate...

Kaoru, who can see the red thread of fate that ties people together, has no red thread of his own, which made him give up hope for finding true love. However, when he meets Hara, he begins to wish he could be with him forever... They choose a future where they will be happy together, and a new life together begins, but what happens after that?

Their arrival will change He Wei's life forever, as all the secrets gradually emerge......

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

138597.description:
On the day of her high school entrance exam, Momo was groped by a stranger on the train. Another student heading to the exam, a boy, saved her. Ever since, she's been searching for her savior amongst her new classmates, and has decided that it must be the school playboy, Amagase. Yoshiki still wishes from the bottom of his heart to always stay by his side...but is there even a Hikaru left to be with?

That fragile restraint shatters in an instant when Jihyeok accidentally stumbles upon a dildo inside Taeseong's bag.

Realizing the saintly man he idolized actually hides his own secret, intensely dirty desires behind closed doors, a dark flip switches inside Jihyeok. The boundary between innocent affection and raw possessiveness dissolves, opening the door to an intoxicating, uncharted relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

138610.description:
Youkai have their own way of life. Each youkai collects offerings from his own territory, while offering protection and delivering the occasional punishment. Until one day, when a major youkai descended from the heavens…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

138613.description:
Boring magic school student Lucas wakes up one morning with cat ears! Unable to resolve the powerful curse by himself, he turns to his childhood friend and student council member, Dylan, for help. Dylan has changed since childhood. He's now cold and arrogant, but something about the situation weighs on his mind. After some investigation, they discover that the only way to dispel the curse is to sleep with a man, and Dylan bluntly offers to do it.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Cats And Magic Unravel With A Kiss
title.native: 猫と魔法はキスでほどける
title.romaji: Neko to Mahou wa Kiss de Hodokeru

138614.description:
1. (ひと夏のリットルガール)
2. (知識の隠し味)
3. (放課後ミルクラテ)
4. (オアシスに魅せられて)
5. (キミ曜日の後味は)
6. (間がな隙かな満ち満ちて)
7. Gojitsudan (後日談)

Gojitsudan contains the following extras:

8. (知識の隠し味 後日談)
9. (放課後ミルクラテ 後日談)
10. (オアシスに魅せられて 後日談)
11. (キミ曜日の後味は 後日談)
12. (間がな隙かな満ち満ちて 後日談)
synonyms: All I Want is Milk, Wheter I'm Awake or Asleep

title.native: 寝ても覚めても乳ばかり
こちょこちょパコパコびくんびくん

138616.description:
There are no limits to a person’s greed! Thinking they could go to the same high school together, Kanade was shocked to find out that his friend Subaru had disappeared without a trace… When they were younger, Kanade was always saving Crybaby Subaru from bullies. Realizing that he had to become stronger to ensure that Kanade would want to stay by his side, Subaru abruptly decides to go to America right before entering high school. Years later, they meet again. Kanade is head over heels for a popular model, Kannon, and Subaru… still looks as unreliable as ever. And yet, Kanade doesn’t recognize his old friend whatsoever. Determined to prove to Kanade that he has gotten cooler and more reliable over the years, Subaru devises a plan to have Kanade live with him. Thus begins their sharehouse lifestyle together. Wanting to show his growth before unveiling their shared history, Subaru keeps his true identity a secret. But little did Kanade know, that Subaru is hiding not only one, but TWO secret identities!?

(Source: Futekiya) Chapter count includes extras

title.english: Why Don't We Start Sharing For Now?
title.native: とりあえずシェアしませんか？

138617.description: <i>Note: Winner of the 31st Shogakukan Manga Award.<i>

138619.description:
This is the story about a "shopkeeper" who "quit" that stress-filled reality and casually disappeared into another world.
"I want to repay the kindness of the people in that other world! With an elf who I found collapsed on the road to help at the register, I, the shopkeeper, opened a small shop. The goods I have lined up are from modern society! Sugar and coffee, chainsaws, and plastic bags, today we'll sell all we can!
Our another-world C-mart is full of customers, ranging from our neighbour "oba-chan" to children to dwarf-smiths and even legendary adventurers!?
In my relaxed, slow life as shopkeeper, with a carefree attitude we're open for business today as well!"
synonyms: Welcome to [C] mart in Another World

138620.description: Special volume that details Kyouya's year as GJ-Club president. Also has some chapters detailing the little sisters after their middle school graduation.

138622.description: Ryo runs a small bento shop in the shopping district. One day, a hungry young man went down at the storefront and collapsed from hunger. His name is Kotaro, a fledgling novelist who speaks inaudibly quietly with unkempt glasses on his unkempt head. It seems that Kotaro couldn't write his debut novel, and has been running away from his responsibilities. Up to the point that he can’t get a normal job to pay bills and his electricity, gas and water were cut-off. "Ryo-san's bento tastes like a family." He grew up in an orphanage and was happy to eat while saying that he had never had a meal with his family.

138623.description:
Park Hwi-Rim has the biggest crush on his team lead...until the tables turn.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Note: Includes five side stories.

138624.description:
Yoonho seems to have it all: he is the successful VP of Top Entertainment and married to an A-list celebrity. But when he’s faced with a terminal illness, the shallow people he relied upon disappear, and he’s on his deathbed filled with regret. Unexpectedly, Yoonho awakens ten years in his past as a rookie talent agent at Hoop Entertainment, the company that nurtured his career. His goal: boost his loyal circle of actor and idol contacts to reach their full potential! With a decade of experience, will Yoonho be able to set this industry right?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Rookie Talent Agent Knows It All

138625.description:
Baroness Eleanor Mariche, renowned novelist and relationship expert, has been summoned by an ambitious duke to convince his son, Count Ryan Calabria, into marrying the princess. The problem is… not only does the count have no interest in the princess, he seems to have fallen for Eleanor instead! Now, she must deal with the wrath of his unhappy father, and also defend herself against a two-faced princess! Will she emerge victorious in this struggle for love and power?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Didn't Mean to Seduce the Male Lead
ฉันไม่ได้อ่อยท่านเคานต์จริงๆ นะ

title.english: I Didn't Mean to Seduce the Male Lead!

138626.description:
Choi Kang-Hui has no friends and is often misunderstood due to his scary appearance, but all he really wants in life are some friends. One day, he returned home to mourn for his grandmother's death anniversary, but a strange turn of events ends up reuniting Kang-Hui with his grandma! Can they work together to create new friends, or did it just turn more difficult?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra and an epilogue.

138627.description:
Cierra Elburke and Claude LeSpencer, both sharing backgrounds of illegitimacy, find refuge from the scorn of their family and society in each other’s arms. But when Cierra is forced to marry someone other than her beloved, she begs for another chance at life with a happier ending. Through the power of the “key” to the throne that is gifted by Claude, Cierra is given a chance to start over. Yet this time, she chooses to leave everything behind, including Claude, with hope for a better life. Has she made the right choice, or will this second chance prove more disastrous than her original fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: シエラ～運命を変える鍵～

138628.description:
The three kingdoms, the era where heroes flocked in order to defeat the world. The best-armed follicles got lost in history due to a momentary mistake. The last moments of life…

“Give me one more chance, I promise I’ll defeat the world!”

When I opened my eyes, the follicle was in its twenties. It went back in time, with its tumultuous spirit beginning to unfold!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

138629.description:
Sun is determined to make a good impression at her new job. The only problem is, her boss is an old classmate from high school - the notoriously stuck-up Do-Yeong - and he’s making her life hell. But the tables turn when Sun discovers her boss’ scandalous secret. After all, if word got out about Do-Yeong’s night time naughtiness, it could ruin his career. Will Sun make him get on his knees and beg for mercy? Or will they come to a steamy agreement?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

138630.description:
He could never tell him the way he feels about him... but getting physical is different!! Keita is on the hunt for love, but he always seems to get dumped and end up fighting. Ryujiro (Ryu) is his friend since high school that he seeks refuge with, who tends to his wounds... the very guy who made Keita develop a habit of falling for straight guys, and Keita has been in love with him forever. Ryu is a nice guy who was willing to oblige Keita when he got drunk and said he might die if he didn't get horizontal with someone. He holds his hand and rocks him like a lover, so sweetly that Keita can't help getting the wrong idea...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 歩き巫女九尾 戸石城炎情―歩き巫女艶闘伝
title.romaji: Aruki Miko Kyuubi Toishijou Ensei: Aruki Miko Entoden

138632.description:
Izumi Fukuya is 27 and single. His hobbies are collecting figures and gaming, and 99% of his shopping is done online. He is truly a homebody. Izumi's current fascination is with sexy delivery driver Tsuchiya! With his manly physique and warm smile, the days when he shows up are sure to be radiant. In the hopes of a rendezvous beyond his doorstop, Izumi spends day after day ordering otaku merch as an excuse to see Tsuchiya. This isn't a forbidden love... rather one man's crush on a cool, heroic guy!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Notes:
- Includes the two-part story "Oretachi ga Motenai Honto no Riyuu".
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Ore-tachi ga Motenai Honto no Riyuu
俺たちがモテないホントの理由

138633.description:
Yumi Katagiri (a pseudonym) is a high school girl who does a bit of compensated dating on the side. But her "customer service," is a little bit different from other girls'... She would continue this behavior night after night until one day she is discovered by her high school teacher. A unique romantic suspense between a lonely girl and a passionate teacher!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

138635.description: Late at night, Sakura goes on a food adventure with his father's notebook. Guided by the moonlight, she arrives at his destination in the evening - a story about sake, food, and family by Outarou Maijou.

138638.description:
Kamiki, a high school student, saw his family being torn apart by bullies.
One day, a mysterious life form gives Tomizawa a powerful "power" that allows him to easily kill people...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

138639.description:
Miogi Sakurai has started a flower shop without flowers, where he proposes flowers to suit each client. While responding to and being pushed around by the clients who come to the store, he solves their problems by combining the characteristics of plants and people's thoughts.
One day, Fuka Miyagawa, who is having trouble with her work and her life, enters the flower shop. Their encounter will eventually change him as well...

(Source: Comico, translated)

138640.description:
Abe no Seimei, an Onmyoji half-man and half-demon, possesses extraordinary powers. He has sent the twelve divine generals, including Taiyin, Genbu and Seiryu, to serve as his messengers... but disasters are beginning to awake around him.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

138641.description:
On her thirteenth birthday, Rian came to Lychee Castle to ask the emperor of the Red Kanade Kingdom to admit her to the imperial court. She had studied hard to become the emperor's favorite consort, but when she finally made it to the audience hall, she was met by Xiao Tsuki, who had just usurped the throne and taken over as the new emperor. What's more, he announces something very surprising: he's going to welcome Rian as the Empress instead of a consort!?
This is the beginning of a love story between Rian, who has become the usurper's empress, and the emperor, Xiao Yue, who has taken Rian to be his wife.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 十三歳の誕生日、皇后になりました。
title.romaji: Juusan Sai no Tanjoubi, Kougou ni Narimashita.

138642.description:
On her thirteenth birthday, Rian is sent to join the harem of the emperor of Sekisou Kingdom. However, the person receiving her is Akatsuki, who had usurped the throne through "legitimate means" to become the new emperor! Rian is made empress, as she is deemed "suitable," but even though they share a bed, Akatsuki treats her like a child, like a hot water bottle to warm his bed. To help Rian sleep, Akatsuki challenges her with a problem to solve every night!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 十三歳の誕生日、皇后になりました。
title.romaji: Juusan Sai no Tanjoubi, Kougou ni Narimashita.

138643.description:
Northern Song Dynasty, during the reign of King Huizong: Aila, the princess of the Golden Kingdom, is assigned to visit the capital of the Song Dynasty as a goodwill ambassador on behalf of the royal family. However, on her way, she is attacked by assassins. She falls in love at first sight with Rinshi, a young fireworks maker from the Song Dynasty who rescues her. But there is talk of a marriage proposal with the ninth prince of the Song Dynasty, King Kang...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 天上恋歌～金の皇女と火の薬師～
title.romaji: Tenjou Renka: Kin no Oujo to Hi no Kusushi

138644.description:
35 years have passed since the battle between Brave Raideen and the Demon Empire and all the other Super Robot battles. Peace has continued through the generations where Reideen has become a long forgotten legend, that is until the peace is disturbed once again from the appearance of 2 Fossil Monsters.

Amongst the continuing screaming by the powerless citizens, an eighth-grader girl hears a mysterious voice from a great titan. The girl's name is Akira Saezuri who heard the voice of Akira Hibiki, the legendary pilot of the titan Reideen. Thus a new battle begins.

138646.description:
Miu Hinata, a high school freshman, spends her busy days taking care of four younger brothers in place of her parents who are often away at work. One day, by chance, she asks her classmate, Fujita, if he would be interested in participating in the parents' relay at her brother's field day. As Miu, who has never spoken to most of the boys in her class, gets to know the mean-sounding but kind Fujita-kun, she begins to develop new feelings for him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes five extras chapters.

138647.description:
They seem like two very different people in the eyes of others. One is cheerful and outgoing; the other is quiet and introverted. "As long as you're willing to read, I'll always write for you." A realistic story between author (writer) and reader (artist).

(Source: Tencent, translated)

138648.description:
The story of a manga artist who was imprisoned by a strange high school girl.

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
synonyms: The Story of When I Was Confined by an Unknown High School Girl
The Story of a Manga Artist Confined by a Strange High School Girl
ผมที่ถูกจองจำกับผู้คุมสาวมัธยมปลาย

title.native: 見知らぬ女子高生に監禁された漫画家の話
title.romaji: Mishiranu Joshikousei ni Kankinsareta Mangaka no Hanashi

138649.description:
After witnessing the death of the woman who saved him as a child, Prince Alexei vows revenge and turns bitter and jaded, eventually taking the throne and becoming Emperor. Little does he know, the woman who saved him was reborn as the daughter of a duke, a taciturn young lady with a secret. When fate throws them together, will they recognize each other, or will their jaded pasts keep them apart?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.english: The Boy I Loved Became the Jaded Emperor
title.native: 無口な公爵令嬢と冷徹な皇帝 ～前世拾った子供が皇帝になっていました～
title.romaji: Mukuchina Koushaku Reijou to Reitetsuna Koutei: Zense Hirotta Kodomo ga Koutei ni Natteimashita

138650.description: A woman born with the appearance of a monster and living in a remote forest rescued a boy who was being attacked by a magical beast. The woman named the boy Ham, and Ham called her Pai. The happy life of two lonely people, however, did not last long, and the boy's beloved Pai, the only person who ever really loved him, was killed in front of him. Ham, whose real identity was the abandoned prince Alexei, fought to become emperor in revenge. Meanwhile, Pai was reincarnated as the duchess Eleonora, widely known as a quiet and secretive beauty. The two are reunited at a fateful ball without knowing anything about each other...?

title.native: 無口な公爵令嬢と冷徹な皇帝～前世拾った子供が皇帝になっていました～
title.romaji: Mukuchina Koushaku Reijou to Reitetsuna Koutei: Zense Hirotta Kodomo ga Koutei ni Natteimashita

138651.description:
According to legend, the world used to be a very different place. Exotic beasts, spirits, and youkai lived with humans in peace. But as time passed and events occurred, the spirits and demons eventually hid themselves away.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Notes:
Season 1: 15 chapters and 2 extras
Season 2: 31 chapters and 6 extras

138652.description:
Attorney Kim Mooil usually only takes simple copyright cases to keep his practice afloat, so when his landlord comes to him and confesses to killing one of his tenants, Mooil thinks it'll be an open-and-shut case. But the day before they're to go to the police, his landlord seemingly takes his own life. As Mooil and his team of sleuths try to solve this mystery, he learns the incident may be linked to a police cover-up, revenge porn, and a murder from seven years ago. So much for open-and-shut!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

138653.description:
No more unrequited love! The hottest rumor in Going High School is that if you put money in the old clothes collection bin and shout out your favorite person's name, it will tell you how the other person feels...!

Song A-Ram, who is only interested in grades and money instead of dating, is not swayed by such rumors. Then Jeong Jin-U, a popular guy at school, suddenly enters A-Ram's daily life. Now what is she supposed to do with a guy who doesn't know where he's going?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Old Clothes Collection Box of Love

138654.description:
Short stories set in decadent years of World War II, and in the subsequent postwar period.

(Source: AnimeClick, translated)

138655.description:
Evil mage Fiona Green was destined to die at the hands of the protagonist couple in “The Emperor and the Saint.” That is, until the story’s author became Fiona herself! Though mistreated, cast out by her pompous family and thrown into the battle at Heylon, Fiona is determined to use her magic for good. But things take a rather unexpected turn when she rescues the male lead, Siegren, turning him from foe to friend… Will she successfully rewrite her fate without changing the story’s happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Wife of the Male Lead
ラスボスの私が主人公の妻になりました
成為我筆下男主角的妻子
ฉันกลายเป็นภรรยาของพระเอก

138656.description: Thinking about her… in his dreams?

title.native: コスプレチェンジ～ピュア系女子大生の危険な性癖～
title.romaji: Cosplay Change: Pure-kei Joshidaisei no Kiken na Seiheki

138659.description:
Rangderkessel, the greatest mage of the land, sacrifices his life to seal the king of destruction, Persiadis, in six sacred relics. The relics are distributed among six different hands to be kept safe, and once again, peace is restored. However, when someone begins to collect the relics to resurrect the demon, Rangderkessel awakens from a 600-year slumber as the boy “Ranghae.”

(Source: WEBTOON)

138660.description:
Sangjin seems like your typical average joe working part-time at a convenience store. That is until you find out he lives with a human-eating monster. To keep the monster's appetite satisfied, he feeds the monster humans whom he deems to be trash of the world. One day, a girl named Jiwon, who believes the monster to be a god, decides to move in with the two. With the police closing in on Sangjin as the main suspect in the recent disappearances, how long will he be able to get away with this?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

138661.description:
A mysterious meteorite crashes into a school and many students are killed and even more are seriously injured. Five students inexplicably come out of the wreckage unscathed and gain supernatural powers while becoming outcasts at school. As they begin to search for answers, they become targets for a secret government program that tests the group’s abilities for reasons unknown to them all.

(Source: Tapas)

138662.description:
Saionji, a housework-application employee who doesn't do housework, is enjoying the freedom of single life she's finally obtained after 38 years! However, she meets Kusumi, a genius engineer from Silicon Valley.

The strange younger man has a big "secret"!

title.native: 西園寺さんは家事をしない

138664.description: A doting love story between a thirty-ish office lady and her neighbor 10 years younger!

title.native: ｰ10歳!? 年下男子の高橋くんは今日も愛を囁く
title.romaji: -10 Sai!? Toshishita Danshi no Takahashi-kun wa Kyou mo Ai wo Sasayaku

138665.description:
An ordinary housewife's life turns to hell after falling into the hands of a vicious loan shark.

(Source: Toptoon)

138666.description:
A master elementalist, Egret lived his entire life in the company of elemental spirits, having felt shunned by human society for his immense power. After his death, he is reborn as the young prince Judas, a social outcast bullied for his quietness and small frame. With his trusty spirits by his side, Egret enters the elite academy Ruvar-H, where he must make friends and turn Judas’ reputation around. But with danger from his past life following him, can this great sage make it in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

138667.description:
A paradise for all men. But is it really a festival for everyone there?

(Source: Toomics)

synonyms: It Was So Hot After All

title.romaji: Hito no Koi to Neko no Koi no

synonyms: JKたちが王様ゲームする

138672.description:
For as long as I can remember, I've been fascinated by violence. But the fixation turned out to be a disguised longing for pain, and in turn, my deepest, darkest secret. I can't let anyone find out, but I also can't help but wonder - will I ever find someone to quench my desires? Or will my fantasy remain unfulfilled... forever? What lies in the end of a pain-fueled revenge?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Gosuwi Danpyeonseon (고수위 단편선) Collection.

synonyms: 空からこぼれたストーリー

138684.description:
Himari Inuzuka, a cheerful girl who's never been in love, and Yuu Natsume, a flower-loving boy, became friends by chance. Two years later, the two are still best friends. But when Yuu is reunited with his former crush, the relationship between Himari and Yuu began to change......?

(Source: Dengeki Daioh, translated)
synonyms: 男女之间的友情存在吗？（不，不存在！！）
Can a Boy and Girl Friendship Hold Up? (No It Can't)

title.native: 男女の友情は成立する？（いや、しないっ!!）
title.romaji: Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)

138686.description:
1. Sensei no Otsutome (先生のオツトメ)
2. Sensei Senyou (先生専用)
3. Aigan Sensei (愛玩先生)
4. Nude Dessin (ヌードデッサン)
5. Yamaura Sensei no Yuutsu (山浦先生の憂鬱)

7. Sensei-Tachi no Natsu no Yoru (先生達の夏の夜)
8. Kyuujitsu♡Mizuirazu (休日♡水入らず)

title.native: 異世界アイドル: 異世界でアイドルデビューしたら聖女扱いされてしまいました
title.romaji: Isekai Idol: Isekai de Idol de Byuu Shitara Seijo Atsukai Sarete Shimaimashita

138690.description:
I did it for the money...! But if I could turn back time, I would stop myself from entering that shop...!

(Source: Toomics)

138691.description:
After a millennium of cultivation, I am the most beautiful and bewitching red-fox spirit. It'll be easy for me to charm that young weakling of a king? No man should be able to resist me? Wait, something's not right here. Your majesty, please stop, don't tempt me!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

138692.description:
A hot shot in the entertainment industry with a rookie actor? A greasy CEO and an internet celebrity falling in love? No, this is about the sweet love between a stunning lady boss and a popular up-and-coming actor!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: This Boy Got Me Falling Hard
My Boyfriend Got Me Fell In Love

title.english: My Boyfriend Got Me Falling in Love

title.native: なんでも吸い込む! ブラックホール!!　(´・ω・｀)ノ●～～～～ (゜ロ゜;ノ)ノ あらゆる敵を「しゅおんっ」と吸い込んで無双する!!!
title.romaji: Nan demo Suikomu! Black Hole!!: (´・ω・｀)ノ●~~~~(゜ロ゜;ノ)ノ Arayuru Teki wo (Shuon) to Suikonde Musou suru!!!

138694.description:
A defenseless, voluptuous, tanned, boyish girl, Rio, has been wearing a cute bra!!

Perverted childhood friends get aroused and attack the hidden deca-breasts....

Inserted into without patience, Rio experiences pleasure for the first time!

(Source: GOT, translated)

Note: Published in Comic ExE #31

138695.description:
Reach for heaven with your high-pitched voice. ♥

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2018-07, 2019-03, and 2019-05

138696.description:
We don't date, we don't kiss, because she doesn't want that.
"You're in love with another man, but I'm still in love with you."
An unhealthy love story between a devoted boy and a dependent girl.

(Source: Monthly Comic REX, translated)

title.native: 僕の彼女は僕のことが好きじゃない
title.romaji: Boku no Kanojo wa Boku no Koto ga Sukijanai

138697.description:
Two handsome brothers. One is sweet and caring, the other cool and aloof. She likes them both, that's what makes it so hard...

Note: A winner in the 6th Betsuma Newcomer Manga Grand Prix Debut contest.

title.native: いつかに変わるその瞬間

138698.description:
They were the only two brothers in this large house. The wedding of the younger brother, now head of the family after a gruesome battle of succession, was held in a solemn manner. The bride's face is hidden behind a thick veil, and everyone calls her the "faceless wife". Then on the wedding night, as they make love, the groom lifts her veil to reveal the face of his elder brother, who was supposed to be dead.

(Source: Libre, translated and edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Sous le linceul de la mariée

138701.description:
Ji-Na, who has a mediocre talent, but is forced to play the violin as the only daughter of a big company. Gyeong-Mi, who had a genius talent, but was born as the daughter of a poor chauffeur and gave up on playing the piano. As Gyeong-Mi's father works as a driver for Ji-Na's family, the two meet and get closer through the link of music. Three years of puberty with music, they feel friendship and gradually love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a two-chapter epilogue.

138702.description: Continuation of the story between Rei and Miyoshi from Amaeru Kubiwa. Both happen to meet each other when going on a trip for work. Some bits of Miyoshi's past are also revealed.

138704.description:
When the infamy of the Demon King echoes to the ocean's depths, Yuria, the king of the sea, decides to venture onto land and challenge them. However, the very act of gaining two legs robs her of all her power, transforming her into a helpless child. Now faced with this unexpected twist of fate, can Yuria rise above this setback and defeat the Demon King to claim her place as the most powerful being in the world?

(Source: WEBTOON)

One Step for the Dark Lord
หนึ่งก้าวสู่เจ้ามาร

title.english: One Step Closer to the Demon King

138705.description:
Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him.

The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

138706.description:
What’s a guy to do when his life suddenly changes while innocently enjoying a nice, cold drink after work? And I mean really changes. This middle-aged commoner now finds himself in the body of Liam Hamilton, the young son of a noble house teetering on the brink of collapse. Between his fervidly desperate father and his utterly apathetic brothers, the only bright side to his new situation is that Liam can finally try learning magic like he’s always wanted. Little does he know his hobby of choice may be about to turn his life upside-down yet again! Will Liam be able to master the craft of magic? And will it be enough to save him from the shadow looming over his family...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou o Kiwamete mita

title.english: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic
title.native: 没落予定の貴族だけど、暇だったから魔法を極めてみた
title.romaji: Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwamete mita

138707.description:
Aiji Kano has a crush on a student who goes to the same cram school as him, but it's game over before he can even confess his love. Just as he's feeling down, he's warned by his cram school teacher, Yoshito Ayabe, about his dropping grades. Irritated, Aiji claims his sexual frustration as the reason. He provokes Yoshito, who has a similar presence to Aiji's unrequited love, and in the heat of the moment, Aiji covers his own eyes, tells Yoshito not to make a sound, and takes him right there. As they continue their twisted relationship, something happens and Aiji comes to know a surprising side of Yoshito. With that, his feelings toward Yoshito change bit by bit... In addition, a love story starring Aiji's crush from a different school, Shu Tachibana, is also included!

(Source: Renta!)

138708.description:
A youth tale about leading a beautiful girl, who was about to jump, to a happy life.

I’m neither antisocial or cheery, and I’m in the middle of the school caste.
But one day, on the rooftop, I encountered the famous ‘The Perfect and Beautiful Girl Loved by God’, Mitsumine Iroha, who was about to jump off.

“Leave me alone. I want to die already.”

Ever since I stopped her, we started spending our days together. We ate pizza in an empty classroom, and played with fireworks by the pool at night. “It’s fun being with you.” “I can’t die because of you, right?” Despite being scared of the gazes of others, Mitsumine begins to slowly open her heart. The girl who wears the mask of ‘A Perfect Me’, is actually childish and adorable.

This is a story about leading a troubled beautiful girl to an ordinary and happy youth.

title.native: 君のせいで今日も死ねない。
title.romaji: Kimi no Sei de Kyou Mo Shinenai.

138709.description:
On a winter day, he fell in love with a man who he knows nothing about, including his true name, age, or job... Hajime is the son of the CEO of a major automobile manufacturer. He's the ideal star student, but he's hard to approach and is a loner in his class. As he passes his days with unending boredom, he meets a mysterious man wearing a suit. The man calls himself "Hirose" and jokingly tells Hajime that he's on the run. Hajime takes an interest in Hirose and visits him from time to time to see how he's doing...
This is an "unusual" love found by a lonely high school student. Witness a sentimental love story about two guys who are far apart in age centering on youthful adolescence and their struggles.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

138710.description:
Yuki Wakura has graduated from high school and is now a college freshman.
As he sets out to live on his own, he unexpectedly bumps into a former classmate on his moving day.
He's stunned to discover that he's moving into an apartment that another young man has also rented. It's Shoma Yuki, a high school friend he had a secret crush on...! Just when Yuki has finally gotten over his old crush and decided to look for someone new...
They both have the name "Yuki", and that has confused the elderly landlords...

This is the story of a chance encounter that turns into home, sweet home for two lovebirds!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: この場所で暮らしたら

138711.description:
When famous wildlife photographer Narumi comes to Hokkaido to take photos of the elusive "snow fairies," he ends up stranded in a snow storm. After being rescued, he takes up residence in local farmer Haruki's house for the winter. As polar opposites, sophisticated and outgoing city slicker Narumi and country boy Haruki have a lot to learn from one another.

After Haruki shows an interest, Narumi teaches him about photography... and before he realizes it, he finds himself the sole subject of Haruki's new hobby. After a winter spent so close together, what will the spring thaw bring?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: チート・ギャンブルー謀略博戯ー
婚活喪女とナチュラルストーカー

138715.description:
1. Tenshi to Koi to Okuman Chouja (天使と恋と億万長者, The Secret Millionaire); 2008-11-11
Until the two rings are reunited, the path to true love will be difficult for the Covelli family... Rick Covelli, made a millionaire from a recent success on an oil rig, doesn't believe in nonsense like curses. Especially not the one supposedly placed on the family rings-even though a string of bad luck, starting with his father's death in an accident, has continued to plague him. Now, he's returned to help his family in his native Indiana, only to be drawn like a magnet to the blue-eyed Jill...

2. Yurusarenai Ai (許されない愛, The Man, the Ring, the Wedding); 2008-12-11
Until the two rings are reunited, the path to true love will be difficult for the Covelli family... Angelina Covelli has lived to work since she lost the man she loved...until she meets CEO John Rossi on the job, and feels her hardened heart start to melt. Unfortunately, she then finds out that his ancestors are the ones who placed a curse on her family...

3. Ai ni Akogarete (愛に憧れて, Her Surprise Family); 2017-09-30
True love is the only way to reverse the curse of the ring.
As long as the two rings remain apart, the Covellis will struggle to find love. This is the curse of the ring that has been passed down for generations. Rafe Covelli inherited his late father’s construction company and he worked hard to rebuild it. One day, he received a request for a renovation from a woman named Shelby, who had bought the town’s historic manor. Rafe decided to give her a hand even though she couldn’t afford to pay him in full. But Shelby didn’t trust Rafe’s kindness and kept turning down his offer. Will Rafe ever be able to open up the heart of this woman who was abandoned by her parents?

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: Tenshi to Koi to Okuman Chouja
The Man, the Ring, the Wedding

138718.description:
The young man may seem like a weak cornered rabbit, but he's actually hunting for tigers by pretending to be prey. As the fates would have it, that haughty girl is tougher than she looks! The dour and cynical boy wanders the world alone, his background full of mystery. As he gains new companions, will they break free from the bonds of fate?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

138719.description:
Within the tenth-floor boss room of the Sazardon Labyrinth, the mighty minotaur awakens once more. Unlike its predecessors, slain at the hands of treasure-seeking adventurers, this monster’s primal urges push it further than ever before. Kill. Consume. Grow stronger. The more powerful its opponent, the more powerful it becomes. Even the very rules of the labyrinth seem to bend to its indomitable will. Can none triumph against this bovine behemoth? Will the minotaur ever meet its match…?

(Source: Yen Press)

138720.description:
Legend has it that the Yan River's Dragon King demands the sacrifice of a young beauty every year. This time I, Cui Su, swear that I will rid him once and for all. However, why are things not turning out the way I expect them to? How did I end up cross dressing and becoming the dragon king's bride?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Yao Bei E Long Chi Diao Le

138721.description:
After enduring a long period of resentment and coldness from his partner, Cheng Jin decides to let him go following their bankruptcy. However, destiny intervenes when his lover suddenly loses his memories and falls in love with Cheng Jin once again. Although Cheng Jin is overjoyed, he is also anguished as he anxiously awaits the arrival of the inevitable “limited time” for their love.

(Source: INKR)

138722.description:
Azumi, an apprentice bartender, has been training his body with just this thought in mind. The huge change in his physique and body are the result of his all his hard work, but ironically, they throw his hormone balance out of whack. Now even when he takes a suppressant, his body can suddenly go into heat. In the midst of one of these attacks, he meets a suspicious man, who offers him a Chinese herbal medicine and gives him a business card for a Traditional Chinese Medicine shop...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Kimi to Tsugai ni Naru Shouhou

138724.description:
Twelve years ago, Makoto-bobo, Airi's surrogate older brother, moved to Tokyo to become a chef. Airi chases him to his bachelor pad in Tokyo, to make good on their childhood promise. So, why does Makoto-bobo still treat Airi like a kid after all this time...? Now's the time for Airi to show him she's a grown woman, so he'll make her his bride!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Shall I Swear True Love, Makoto? -Please Be My First-
title.native: まことの愛を誓いますか～私のハジメテ、もらってください～
title.romaji: Makoto no Ai wo Chikaimasuka, Watashi no Hajimete, Moratte Kudasai

138726.description:
What happens when a former martial emperor gets reborn into a complete loser's body? Gu Feiyang, a legendary martial artist who was ranked third-strongest in the continent, finds himself in this predicament when he wakes up in the body of 15-year-old Li Yunxiao. Li Yunxiao was once a failure who had yet to open a single chakra portal in his body, but now he's morphed into a genius martial artist overnight and becomes the talk (and target) of the town. Armed with the expertise of his former life, Li Yunxiao is on a mission to complete the ultimate incantation that killed him in the first place - all while wiping the floor with his former bullies at school. Will he be able to exceed the accomplishments of his previous life? One thing's for certain: no one will ever call him a loser again!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: The title of the manhua changed from 万古至尊 to 这一世我要当至尊 starting from Ch. 14.

138730.description:
The college girl Hinami is a huge fan of the idol Kaneto Shinonome. Other people criticize him for appearing cold and uncaring, but that just makes him seem even more god-like in her eyes. Then she ran into Kaneto by chance, and he asked her to help him with his problem…?

(Source: Kurofune x LINE, translated)
