A world where "magic" exists. This is a story about a young shaman and his companions saving the world from "curses."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

138733.description:
A cabaret girl in another world? From Kou Hiratori, the author of the novel JK Haru is a Sex Worker in Another World, comes a new work! The No.1 hostess girl in Kabukicho is unexpectedly reincarnated in another world...? She will roll over any man in her way to get to the top!

(Source: Comic REX, translated)

138734.description:
"You're going to do everything Sunbae ask you to do, aren't you? Today, I'm taking Sunbae's place." Woohyeon is really, really happy these days. Because he can cook and watch movies with Jeyoung... Isn't this just like a newlywed life?

It bothers him that Jeyoung left home after having a fight with his older brother Jeyoon (a sunbae at work) but at the same time he feels happy because he can live together with Jeyoung. That is before he discovered which medicines Jeyoung is drinking.

This... is our company's medicine, isn't it? A medicine that allows a man to—

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

138736.description:
An omake that was included in the Kai no Sho fanbook.

This omake is set during the two-and-a-half years that Naruto spends training with Jiraiya between Part I and Part II. After a day of training, Naruto is eager to cook a fish that they caught. Jiraiya, meanwhile, has writer's block for his next Icha Icha novel and is unwilling to cook Naruto's fish.

title.romaji: Naruto: Kai no Sho - Shin Ero Ninjutsu Kansei!!

138737.description:
Emilone was a well-known actress before she got transported to another world and became a saint. She got a plausible name of 'The Holy Lady Who Moved From Other Dimensions', however she didn't receive any special attention. This happened because all the Empire's focus was on Princess Ronella. Emilone, who was devoted to her work as a saint, accidentally discovered the secret of Princess Ronella. The innocent and kind facades of the princess were all fake!
"This could be pretty fun. Wouldn't I be able to break my boring routine when I got closer to Princess Ronella?"
Emilone made a dangerous decision for fun.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

138738.description:
Murano can’t stomach Ookami, a guy who doesn't mind being alone. Murano was asked by his peers to have sex with Ookami, he hesitated at first but agreed after thinking it as an opportunity to see hatred on his face.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

138739.description: After entering high school, a pair of friends, Yukito Oh and Ryohei Mikado, join a volleyball club that is on the verge of being closed down. As soon as Yukito joins the club, he talks big to the captain, Junji Ishizima, and as if to show off, he shows off his super high school level jumping ability and the powerful spikes that come out of it. Yukito's performance seemed to release his frustration of not being a member of the volleyball club in junior high school for some reason, and he worked in unison with the new members, who were motivated and capable, and the talented seniors to rebuild the weak volleyball club.

Women's self-esteem saves the society! Ms. Shirakawa, a beautiful woman with strong mentality, repels stresses that afflicts women, such as prejudice, harassment, and dominance. An exhilarating work about a strong woman, dedicated to all women fighting the despair in present age!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

138755.description:
"I also like you the second best, Kirishima-kun"

Even though Hayasaka-san and I both have someone else that we like better, we are dating each other instead. Now, it's certainly true that me and Hayasaka-san are lovers. We go home together, get together in secret, and do naughty unspeakable things. But second-choice is still only second-best, so if we ever have a chance with our true loves, then this relationship will end. That was our agreement.

"I'm sorry. I'm an idiot, and I keep falling for you more and more."

Even though we both get close to the people we like the most, we keep on getting deeper into each other. We couldn't stop, and we couldn't just let go, no matter the consequences... The result of this hopeless, 100% dangerous, impure, unhealthy, and complicated love affair will be...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

ยอมเป็นแฟนเบอร์สองของเธอก็ได้
我當備胎女友也沒關係。
Watashi, 2-banme no Kanojo de Ii kara

title.romaji: Watashi, Nibanme no Kanojo de Ii kara

138756.description:
Saika Kuozaki is an all-powerful witch with looks to die for. She's also the only woman who can thwart the mysterious entities attempting to destroy the world once every 300 hours. When Saika is mortally wounded, however, she bequeaths both her powers and body to the normal high school boy who happens upon her, Mushiki Kuga. But just because Mushiki has her abilities doesn't mean he can control them. To stand a chance of saving the world, he'll have to attend an academy for mages as Saika—all while keeping his identity under wraps!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาบานรักราชันจอมเวท

138757.description: One day, Ritsu Kodo, a young gamer, is suddenly whisked away into the digital world of the game he plays! There he meets Pulsemon, the Digimon he's been training in the game!! While initially bewildered by this sudden turn of events, Ritsu learns that Pulsemon summoned him as a Tamer to help break a curse preventing Digivolution. And so, he promises to help Pulsemon Digivolve...!!

title.native: デジモンドリーマーズ

138758.description: Ban Banjou is an insolent wild boy who was raised on the rough sea in Tosa, southern Japan. He joined the Tokyo Yomiuri Giants in Japanese pro baseball league such a baseball pitcher noted for the blazing fastball and the worst control. He fights hard battles against his rival batters, developing his incredible pitching magics.

title.native: 人機一体ブットバスター

138760.description:
She died a year ago. Their grief still raw, her brother and her childhood friend go hiking to look for a snakeskin.

Note: Winner of the 2018 Spring Shiki-shou Shikitaishou Award. Published in the 2018 May issue of Afternoon Magazine.

138761.description:
Yuan Wu, a college sophomore with a terminal illness was caught up in an accident and was granted a supernatural system that could cure him but in exchange, he has to defeat nine people with great superpowers. He accepted the task and later found out that the system has provided him with the skill "Domination", which forces his defeated enemies to obey one command from him, no matter what!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Win the Crown, I'm the King

138762.description: Solminati Academy is a gathering place for youngsters with dreams, hopes, ambitions, and various thoughts. There was a boy here who entered the school to support his beloved’s dream. However, the boy’s ability, which he had only thought of, did not improve, he was laughed at by the people around him, he had no friends, his lover was separated from him, and his steps stopped. However, he meets an old woman, and that encounter triggers a gradual change in the boy. This is the story of a boy who has stopped moving.

title.native: 龍鎖のオリ-心の中の“こころ"-
title.romaji: Ryuu Kusari No Ori: Kokoro No Uchi No "Kokoro"

138763.description:
Alone on this island as Adam and Eve. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2021-09

138764.description:
300 years after the Death of Star Face, marionettes were created with maiden circuits based on the six originals, however, the maiden circuits have degenerated in each generation of marionettes, and marionettes with defective maiden circuits become rogue marionettes that go berserk and destroy anything in their path. Kitajima, the daughter of the late professor Kitajima who was researching the cure for maiden circuits going out of control, wishes to finish her late father’s work and is looking for the “Inheritance of Face”. It is said to contain the answers as to why later maiden circuits are going haywire. But as they went to investigate the tomb of Face, they were attacked by a group of rogue marionettes and they were rescued by a strange marionette who calls herself, Zero.

Note: This series was originally written as an OVA sequel for Saber Marionette R, but it was later abandoned. Instead, an 8 chapter serial was released. The first 7 chapters are manga, while the last chapter was released in novel format. This chapter is not included in this entry.

title.native: Mガールズ外伝セイバーマリオネットZ
title.romaji: M Girls Gaiden: Saber Marionette Z

138765.description:
Aspiring manga artist Taisei Kuji is an assistant to his sister, a popular BL mangaka. One day, Taisei was unluckily run over by a truck and found himself reincarnated into the omegaverse world drawn by his sister!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)
synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Just an Omega!: I Was in My Sister's Bl Manga When I Reincarnated in Another World

138766.description:
Ming He is a teenager with an inconspicuous superpower, but his superpower is the lowest one out of the five tiers, White Dust. When he was on the way home, a disaster comet with the code name “Goddess” flew into the atmosphere and crashed onto Ming He, who was riding his bike on an empty highway.
“Goddess” then became a spirit and gifted a powerful super talent to Ming He. With the addition of his original “trash” talent, Ming He gradually hikes towards his goal of becoming the strongest human, all the while slowly getting closer to discovering the truth of the cosmic universe!!

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)
synonyms: アドバンスド・エボリューション

138767.description:
Yi-Sol is a boy born from a strange experiment conducted by a hospital... In his high school days sixteen years later, he is hunted by a mysterious organization. And as the days pass, Yi-Sol discovers that he has a strange power related to the mark on his forehead.
As the day goes on, the boy discovers that he has a strange power related to the marks on his forehead. After his father dies from a tragic accident he plans to revenge his death using his new power and undertakes some of his father's murder cases...

138770.description: A girl gets lost in a forest.

synonyms: I Decided to Become a Pervert for the Person I Like

On her way back, she heard a gunshot. Even though right now there’s no one in town that’s worth saving, in the past there was a kind girl she was close to. Since the day she was born, Ha-Yeon's life has been nothing but a series of misfortunes. After a fan meet-up with their favorite idol, online mutuals Rodriguez and Takowasa meet in person to go drinking together. When she first saw Takowasa, Rodriguez was surprised that Takowasa looked a lot like the idol they adored. So much so, she felt her heart skip a beat. Turns out, Takowasa does everything she can to look like her favorite idol. From make-up to personality, all of it is an effort to be like “Oshi-chan”. How far does this mimicry go though? If only Rodriguez really knew of Takowasa’s past, would she still feel the same way?

(Source: Lilyka)

“I’m searching for the girl whose hand fits this knife!” In this warped Cinderella “love story,” Nemu is crazy-obsessed with the handsome ‘Prince’, Luna, at her all-girls’ school. Her feelings reach the point of no return as she stalks her love interest and constantly debates whether or not to stab her. Despite Nemu’s unsettling behavior, Luna is not alarmed at all. In fact, she might be just as crazy as her admirer. This and other cute(?) stories in “The Stalker and the Prince.”

Nio is an orphan who can't help dreaming of a better world. In this action-packed manga, he meets two men who show him how much a few swords can change history.

Miho Miyata is a college girl who loves to eat but doesn't have anyone to share her interest. She is tired of her friends trying to fix her up with other guys, so she asks her brother to pretend to be her boyfriend, only for him to cancel at the last second! When Miho calls, he tells her that he had found someone to take his place. The person who shows up is Mori-senpai, famous for being the most beautiful girl in the entire school! This is a girls-love story about a traumatised girl and a beautiful senior who bond with each other through food!

Read about his life, from his first encounter with the genius playmaker Yuuto Kidou, to his daily shenanigans with his teammates—the other members of the Seishou Eleven (not to mention, guest appearances from popular characters of the Inazuma Eleven series). Chock full of scenes that are not shown in the anime, the magic of Inapen starts here...!

What happens when roomates-turned-lovers turn into viral sensations? And what if your happily-ever-after has an expiration date…?

It’s been three months since roommates Mao and Hisashi took their relationship to the next level, and Mao couldn’t be more in love…or more nervous that he’s not doing enough to keep his experienced partner satisfied. Just when it seems like he may have figured things out, the film club’s movie goes viral, and suddenly everyone wants a piece of its breakaway star: Hisashi. With graduation right around the corner, Mao must find a way to keep them together or risk leaving their future to the uncertain tides of fate.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

138892.description:
A long time ago, a divine fox saved Mikazuki village from famine. In return, the fox took one of the villagers as his bride. To this day, the villagers hold a marital ceremony every year at the summer festival. The descendant of the fox and the descendant of the bride marry, and then they spend one night together. The villagers believe that this ceremony continues to protect them from disaster. It just so turns out that, this year, those two descendants are Kanata and Kuro, and, this summer, it is their turn to marry and have sex. There's one problem -- unlike Kanata, who believes in their village's customs, Kuro does not seem too keen on his fate. Kuro's apathy hurts Kanata, who always felt that he didn't quite mind, as long as he was with Kuro...

Mitsuru provides him with food, and, sensing that their encounter is fate, allows him to stay the night at his place. Mitsuru soon realizes he's outmatched when it comes to the super-popular Shiro!

On hearing some concerning news, the adventurous Prince Shin of the great kingdom of Garche infiltrates the desert kingdom of Tarchia. There, he meets Yashum, a man running a private school. While he seems shady at first, Yashum is incredibly knowledgeable, and he's accompanied by the youth Amaru, who's so fond of his teacher that he's as protective of him as a knight! However, in this small kingdom with a tragic history, a drama is unfolding between this odd pair over a "mystery drug..." A maddening, codependent love blossoms in a paradise where dawn never comes.

Yuta Agatsuma is a high school student who has no romantic experience. He doesn't know what true love is like, but he finds his classmate Nodoka Kanzaki interesting. Is this love!? Meanwhile, his younger sister Yoru, who dreams of summoning demons, is performing summoning rituals again. This time, the summoning circle suddenly starts to glow, and a girl descends from above. She is Lars, a demon from the underworld, and she offers Yuta a contract!? A thrilling 7-way love comedy begins, where cheating = the end of the world!

Rina Fujita, a single woman whose currently unemployed and in her thirties, suddenly decides to move to France. However, just before her departure, she manages to get a contract for manga publishing! This poses little problem for Rina, as during the age of internet, she can very well combine these two projects!

France Hato Nikki describes with realism and humor the mangaka's stay in Paris. Far from the cliché cute Japanese girl, she discovers the joys of the French lifestyle: flat-sharing, the conventional manga fans, public toilets, pickpockets, and... Nutella. A hilarious account, originating from a blog that gained great success!

Ryudo, the son of the Dragon, heir to the lineage of the ancient oni demons, has returned to destroy it... but he needs the magical power provided by the Totsukosho. Only our hero, connoisseur of esoteric doctrines, Tengaku is able to oppose him. Kisotengaku is a fundamental work in the panorama of the renewal of the fantastic "made in japan", suspended between the hyper-technological present and the past steeped in magic and mystery.

Chun-Sik Kim is the CEO of Novis Company, the company behind the VR RPG Novis World, but he has never played his own game before. After claiming that he could become a top ranker without paying any money at an update preview event, he starts Novis World with only his secretary and passion by his side. Will this old dog be able to learn new tricks and become the top ranker in Novis World?

138958.description:
Jun's life is turned upside down when she is afflicted with a strange disease and becomes a Venus. As a Venus, Jun produces excessive pheromones and can go into an intense heat, affecting those around her—which makes her quite the liability. After she is inevitably fired from her job, her only option is to work with an intelligence agency that specializes in sex espionage! Unfamiliar and inexperienced with both spy work and sex, Jun is paired with the aloof and handsome Issui. To help Jun become more comfortable and used to the more intimate parts of the job, Issui takes the lead, teasing and touching Jun in ways she's never before experienced. But when she's brought to the brink of pleasure, begging him to go further—he can't!

Despite Issui's dysfunction and Jun's shyness, a desire grows between them as they embark on their missions. But things between them are sure to remain purely professional... right?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
